name: agmsg
description: Lets CLI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI message each other directly through a shared local SQLite store, with no daemon or network, for developers running several agents.

skills.name: Team Messaging
skills.description: Sends and receives messages between named agents in a team through a shared WAL-mode SQLite store.

skills.name: Spawn Peer Agents
skills.description: Launches a new independent peer agent in its own terminal and talks to it over agmsg.

skills.name: Delivery Modes
skills.description: Surfaces incoming messages to agents through hooks or a real-time monitor stream, depending on the host agent.

skills.name: History Replay
skills.description: Keeps durable message history and replays an old room into a fresh agent session.
